parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Relations to add to each 404 host of the answer: one or several of `owner` (the user who created the host), `certificate` (its certificate) and `dns_records` (the states of the host record option as `npmpro_dns_records`, only for hosts that have it), separated by commas.

200.description: The 404 hosts, ordered by domain name

description:
Lists the 404 hosts, ordered by domain name. A user limited to their own items sees only theirs. The `query` query parameter searches domain names, descriptions and tags.

Needs: 404 Hosts view
